title: Robredo thanks PCSO for P25-M hospital equipment for Naga
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Former Vice President and Naga City Mayor Maria Leonor “Leni” Robredo thanked the PCSO for its ₱25.1-million donation of diagnostic equipment to the Naga City General Hospital.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Vice President and Naga City Mayor Maria Leonor “Leni” Robredo thanked the PCSO for its ₱25.1-million donation of diagnostic equipment to the Naga City General Hospital. “We are beyond grateful, not just for these donations, but for what PCSO has been doing for our countrymen,” Robredo said on Thursday during the turnover of the donation, which was held amid the city’s Peñafrancia Festival festivities. “Frequently, you’re the last line of defense. When it comes to times of urgent necessity, people know that they can approach the PCSO, especially when the hospital bills are so big,” she added […]...
